title: The shady side of afterlife
summary: A comic fantasy short story about Rick Dawson, a cheerful, slightly scatterbrained man who finds himself in a vast, crowded afterlife waiting hall after being mistakenly collected from his kitchen while making a banana milkshake. He is stuck with an elderly clerk who keeps a surprisingly modern computer and a bureaucratic attitude toward death, and who explains that the angel who retrieved Rick is a habitual drinker. While Rick waits to be returned to his body, a short, ugly demon with brimstone breath mistakes the black ink circle Rick accidentally smeared on his palm for the mark of a special messenger. The demon blurts out a plot involving an apocalypse and a disguised destroyer, and Rick, too bewildered to correct him, nods along. The story is a light, dialogue-driven satire that plays on afterlife clichés, mangled idioms, and mistaken identity, and ends with a sinister figure in black searching for the demon.
